integrity: The general mathematical proof is self-contained, with a standalone exact-rational supplementary checker. Priority is conditional on available full-text and indexed comparisons; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal patch populations, symmetric bidirectional cycle movement, common recovery; equal positive increments at exactly two sites for the distance-order claims. The spectral threshold is local invasion rather than persistent endemic infection in a closed SIR system. Uniform separation monotonicity is only for mobility below 2/5; five-site reversal and all-rate permutation erasure are specific to C5.
title: A sharp mobility boundary for hotspot spacing in cyclic epidemic networks
